The main takeaway from our work is that
dynamics-aware IL can be achieved by a single Q-learning process without the need for adversarial optimization or biased gradient estimators.

it is not always necessary to explicitly learn a policy or reward function to solve an IL problem, but rather, a Q-function can be learned directly, and the policy can be extracted from it in a straightforward manner.
dynamics-aware imitation learning can be made practical and scalable with a simple, single-step gradient update.
